acceptedAnswer.text: The average cost of a new residential roof installation in the Pasadena area can vary significantly based on several factors, including the roofing material selected (e.g., asphalt shingles, tile, metal), the size and pitch of your roof, the complexity of its design, and the need for any structural repairs or old roof removal. To get an accurate estimate, it's best to schedule a free inspection and consultation. We will provide a detailed quote tailored to your specific home and material preferences.
